name: Qingdao Beverage Group Co., Ltd. (青岛饮料集团有限公司)
via: wholly owned by the Qingdao Municipal SASAC
note: Qingdao municipal state-owned enterprise formed in 2006; owner/operator of the Laoshan Cola (崂山可乐) brand through its subsidiary Qingdao Laoshan Mineral Water Co., Ltd. In March 2025 Qingdao SASAC confirmed a strategic merger placing the group under Tsingtao Brewery Group (also wholly owned by Qingdao SASAC); by March 2026 the beverage group's chairman and party secretary was simultaneously a Tsingtao Brewery Group deputy party secretary and vice-president. Both groups remain Qingdao municipal state enterprises.
